stories.title: New Welsh Cabinet meets for first time with NHS waiting lists among five priorities
stories.summary: First Minister Rhun ap Iorwerth will today chair the first meeting of the new Welsh Government Cabinet. Cutting NHS waiting lists, supporting families with the cost of living, creating jobs, raising standards in education and tackling child poverty are the five priorities set out by the new administration. stories.title: Flintshire veteran support groups can apply for share of £50m UK funding
stories.summary: Flintshire-based organisations supporting armed forces veterans can now apply for UK Government grants of between £200,000 and £1m to join a new £50m national support network. stories.title: Bellway offering up to £20,000 incentives on new homes in Deeside
stories.summary: Housebuilder Bellway is offering incentives worth up to £20,000 on selected new homes at its Summers Bridge development in Deeside until the end of May. stories.summary: Newly elected Llywydd Huw Irranca-Davies sets out his vision for a more open, respectful and accessible Welsh Parliament. stories.title: EastEnders’ Charlie Brooks to star in Curious Incident at Storyhouse Chester
stories.summary: Charlie Brooks and Joe McFadden will lead the cast of The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-time when the UK tour reaches Storyhouse Chester in March 2027. The production runs from Tuesday 16 March to Saturday 20 March 2027, with tickets from £28.50 for Storyhouse Members. General ticket prices have not been announced.
